complexity.notes: best_buy is dead code as written; the intended O(n) single-pass optimization would use best_buy (min price so far) instead of the inner loop. Minor style: iterating range(len(prices)) is cleaner, and prices[i] should be best_buy if the inner loop is removed.
complexity.summary: Brute-force enumeration of every buy index i and sell index j>i, keeping the maximum prices[j]-prices[i]. It tracks best_buy but never actually uses it in the profit update, so the result is still correct for all pairs.
